summary: Autohome Inc. filed Form 6-K announcing the date of its board meeting and publication of Q2 2026 and interim results on August 20, 2026, Hong Kong time. The filing includes details of an earnings conference call and webcast after market hours. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine notice of an upcoming board meeting and earnings release, which does not constitute a special-situations event. The registrant is the issuer/filer, and no deal terms are present. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; merely an earnings calendar announcement.
